notes: Planning proposal only. All source/test execution nodes remain pending and require later execution authorization. Only this proposal file is written in the current task.

Thirteen nodes; five independent evidence/measurement/fixture roots. Shared upstream ownership-contract completion is not a global barrier: local legal identity/API facts gate only affected source edits.

Source ownership is exclusive: cw-generator owns shared generator/config/catalog/templates and build identity projection; cw-transaction owns migrate-strict-effect.ts, io.ts, install.ts, package-cohort.ts and dispatch; cw-legacy owns only enumerated migration leaf transforms; cw-native owns help/content/authored example inputs; cw-retirement-resolution owns only enumerated policy leaves. Read-only references do not grant write ownership.

Generator scope is deliberately one owner rather than parallel file writers. Additional template/module paths discovered by cw-artifact-contract must be enumerated and assigned once before source edits. Existing package manifests/exports/root lockfile/release cohorts/FORK-DIVERGENCE.md stay with program integration owners; provide exact requested patches rather than competing writes.

Source predecessor contracts allow disjoint work, but a frozen proposal is not proof an API exists: each source node records concrete provider handoffs and stops its dependent edits until delivery. Cross-producer and real-cohort proofs wait for actual implementations.

Coverage: user-workflows journeys/acceptance→cw-journeys, artifact contract and update contract; metrics→cw-metrics with after measurements in proofs. generated-surface inventory→cw-artifact-contract, package→cw-generator plus legal provider handoffs, parity→cw-projection-proof. update-transaction classify/minimal/atomic→cw-update-contract and cw-transaction, tarball/no-op/failure proof→cw-transition-proof. legacy-migrations floor→cw-historical-fixtures, transform→cw-legacy, regressions→cw-transition-proof. native-usage commands/examples/instructions→cw-native, generator/dispatch sole-owner handoffs and both proofs. retirement decide→cw-retirement-contract, simplify/prove→cw-retirement-resolution and existing runtime owners.

Source update proof never replaces final whole-candidate integration, real ERP-10/customized/Tractor source acceptance or exact published-byte acceptance. If canonical Tractor exists at implementation time, downstream release owner must update/validate it and preserve visible UI. Existing source/published acceptance and publication plans remain mandatory downstream gates.

Reuse accepted PR49 normalizer/catalog, packaged microvertical-api/code-tools and historical migration ownership recognizers. No app shims, native-API wrappers, synthetic links, copied checkers, second updater/master config, hook bypasses, generated output edits, manual lockfile edits, widened boundary scope or audited identity reset.

Retirement decisions can be gathered at the root; migration proof and affected runtime handoffs gate implementation. Optional emergency policy uncertainty never blocks unrelated mandatory repairs, and retained required capability still must have a lawful zero-debt owner.
